parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The push mode. Valid values:

- **ALL**: pushes to all devices.

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**: pushes to a single device.

- **GROUP_DEVICE**: pushes to devices in a group
parameters.help_zh:
推送模式。

- **ALL**：全量设备推送。

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**：单设备推送。

- **GROUP_DEVICE**：分组设备推送
parameters.name: push_mode

parameters.help_en:
The group ID. This parameter is required when **PushMode** is set to **GROUP_DEVICE**.
You can obtain the group ID from **Device Management** > **Group Management**
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID，当**推送模式**选择为**分组设备**时，该项必填。
您可以在**设备管理** > **分组管理**中获取分组ID，
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. When **PushMode** is set to **SINGLE_DEVICE**, you must specify either this parameter or the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID。当**推送模式**选择为**单个设备**时，该参数与**ProductKey**、**DeviceName**组合二选一必传。

> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the product
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of speech corpus IDs to push. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html to obtain the IDs.

N is an integer. Valid values: 1 to 100. A maximum of 100 speech corpora can be pushed at a time
parameters.help_zh:
需要推送的语料ID列表。该参数可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html查询获取。

N为整数，取值范围：1~100，表示每次最多推送100条语料
parameters.name: speech_code_list
